description: Browser checkout URL for a cart — FALLBACK ONLY, for edits the CLI can't make: swap payment method, opt out of credits, change address mid-checkout, enter a promo code, or finish an age-restricted order. Do not offer by default after previews.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

name: get_checkout_url
